card.name: Digit 8 after 1 in dates
card.fires_on: The digit 8 (sometimes 7) right after a leading 1, as the second digit of a day number like 18 or of a year like 1894. It appears mostly in dates in news, history and web page datelines.

modes.label: Day of month
modes.description: The 8 or 7 in a day number such as 18 or 17 right after a month name.

modes.label: Year in the 1800s
modes.description: The 8 in a year of the 1800s, written as 18xx.
